name: Suede

whyMatters.en: London band often dated to Britpop’s opening: debut Suede (1993) and Bernard Butler’s guitar drama on Dog Man Star (1994) put androgynous glam before Oasis stadium consensus.
whyMatters.zh: 常被算作 Britpop 开局的伦敦乐队：首专 Suede（1993）与 Bernard Butler 在 Dog Man Star（1994）的吉他戏剧，把中性 glam 放在 Oasis 体育场共识之前。

lyricQuotes: Animal nitrate / Like she said you get used to anything
It's the beautiful ones / That make you feel so small

shortBio.en: Brett Anderson / Bernard Butler glam-Britpop; Dog Man Star drama, Coming Up pop singles with Oakes.
shortBio.zh: Brett Anderson / Bernard Butler 的 glam-Britpop；Dog Man Star 戏剧，Oakes 时期 Coming Up 流行单曲。

body.en:
Formed 1989 in London. Debut Suede (1993) won the Mercury Prize race with Brett Anderson’s androgynous vocal and Bernard Butler’s wah-heavy guitar. Dog Man Star (1994) pushed orchestral glam before Butler’s departure.

Coming Up (1996) with Richard Oakes returned sharper chart singles—Beautiful Ones, Trash. They open Britpop’s glam/art-school lane before Manchester anthem dominance.
body.zh:
1989 年于伦敦组建。首专 Suede（1993）以 Brett Anderson 中性人声与 Bernard Butler wah 重吉他在 Mercury 奖赛道上胜出。Dog Man Star（1994）在 Butler 离队前推进管弦 glam。

Richard Oakes 加入后的 Coming Up（1996）回到更锐榜单单曲——Beautiful Ones、Trash。他们在曼彻斯特颂歌主导前打开 Britpop 的 glam/艺术学院车道。

note.en: Butler wah/distortion peaks; Brett’s falsetto over glam chord stabs.
note.zh: Butler wah/失真峰值；Brett 假声压在 glam 和弦刺上。

note.en: Dog Man Star epic; Butler exit follows this cycle.
note.zh: Dog Man Star 史诗；Butler 在此周期后离队。

note.en: Coming Up pop pivot; Oakes replaces Butler on sharper singles.
note.zh: Coming Up 流行转向；Oakes 接替 Butler 写更锐单曲。

title.zh: 体育场 Oasis 之前的 glam Britpop

body.en:
Animal Nitrate and The Drowners frame Suede’s method: Brett’s dramatic falsetto, Butler’s distortion/wah, Mat Osman’s melodic bass. Androgynous image as chart fact in 1993.

Dog Man Star escalates length and orchestration—the art-glam document before Britpop’s laddish turn.
body.zh:
Animal Nitrate 与 The Drowners 框定 Suede 方法：Brett 戏剧假声、Butler 失真/wah、Mat Osman 旋律贝斯。1993 年中性形象作为榜单事实。

Dog Man Star 拉长时长与配器——Britpop 兄弟化转向前的 art-glam 文献。

title.en: Butler era vs Oakes pop pivot
title.zh: Butler 时期 vs Oakes 流行转向

body.en:
Bernard Butler (1989–1994) defines the guitar drama on debut and Dog Man Star. Richard Oakes joins 1994; Coming Up trades epics for three-minute pop hooks.

Osman/Gilbert rhythm section bridges both eras.
body.zh:
Bernard Butler（1989–1994）定义首专与 Dog Man Star 的吉他戏剧。Richard Oakes 1994 年加入；Coming Up 用三分钟流行钩子换掉史诗。

Osman/Gilbert  rhythm section 连接两个时期。

title.en: Glam guitar into post-punk revival indie
title.zh: Glam 吉他进入后朋克复兴 indie

body.en:
Franz Ferdinand and later UK indie cite Suede’s androgynous frontman + angular guitar pairing. They sit upstream of 2000s art-school guitar revival.

Influence line runs through glam drama, not Oasis chord anthems.
body.zh:
Franz Ferdinand 与后来英国 indie 引用 Suede 的中性主唱 + 棱角吉他配对。他们站在 2000 年代艺术学院吉他复兴上游。

影响线走 glam 戏剧，而非 Oasis 和弦颂歌。
